title: What If You Never Forgot a Single Day of Your Life?

scenes.text: What if you never forgot a single day? A few people really can't.
It's called highly superior autobiographical memory. By 2012, researchers had confirmed thirty-three people.
Give them any date, and they instantly name the day of the week, about ninety-nine percent right.
They remember what they did and what was in the news on that day, in detail, from about age ten.
Brain scans show differences in nine brain structures, including stronger white matter linking the front and middle of the brain.
One woman called her memory non-stop, uncontrollable and totally exhausting. Remembering everything is not the gift it sounds like.

description:
What if you never forgot a single day of your life?
A handful of people can recall almost every day from age ten, and researchers found differences in their brains.
What should we run through next?
